items.source: Returns a new AccessOptions that will cause paths that contain null values to be skipped when setting a property.
items.translation: 返回一个新的AccessOptions，该选项将在设置属性时跳过包含空值的路径。

items.source: Sets the given value for the PersistentProperty pointed to by the given PersistentPropertyPath considering the given AccessOptions.
items.translation: 为给定的PersistentProperty设置指定值，该属性由给定的PersistentPropertyPath指向，并考虑给定的AccessOptions。

items.source: Returns the default AccessOptions.SetOptions rejecting setting values when finding an intermediate property value to be null.
items.translation: 返回默认AccessOptions.SetOptions，该选项在查找中间属性值时若结果为 null 则拒绝设置值。

items.source: Returns a new AccessOptions that will cause paths that contain null values to be skipped when setting a property but a log message produced in TRACE level.
items.translation: 返回一个新的AccessOptions，该选项在设置属性时会跳过包含 null 值的路径，但会在 TRACE 级别生成日志消息。

items.source: Shortcut to configure the same AccessOptions.SetOptions.Propagation for both collection and map property path segments.
items.translation: 快捷方式，用于为集合和 Map 属性路径段配置相同的 AccessOptions.SetOptions.Propagation。

items.source: Base package for the mapping subsystem.
Uses of AccessOptions.SetOptions in org.springframework.data.mapping
items.translation: org.springframework.data.mapping 中 AccessOptions.SetOptions 的用法
